name: easi-run-client
description: The easi.run web viewer, its SDK and the admin page: lossless deflate tiles, WebCodecs video, drawn with WebGL2 or Canvas 2D; the page is Svelte and Tailwind.

scripts.build: npm run check && vite build && node scripts/build.mjs --sdk && node scripts/build.mjs --compress
scripts.test: npm run check && node scripts/build.mjs --tests && node --test .test-out/
